formHeader.title: Add handover package
formHeader.description: Leave edifice, floor, or unit empty to apply this checklist at that scope. Units inherit ancestor items.

help.title: About adding a handover package
help.overview: You are creating a checklist configuration, not ticking work on a sale. Choose the narrowest scope this list should apply at. Open sales for units under that scope will pick up these items on the next sync.

sections.title: How to pick the scope
items: Leave edifice, floor, and unit empty for a project-wide list that every unit in the project inherits.
Fill edifice (and leave floor and unit empty) for building-level extras.
Fill floor (and leave unit empty) for floor-level extras. Fill unit for items that apply only to that unit.
Ancestors are filled automatically from the leaf. After save, scope cannot be changed — create a new package at a different scope instead.

sections.title: Uniqueness
items: There can be only one package per project, per edifice, per floor, and per unit.
A second package at the same scope is rejected. Edit the existing one instead.

sections.title: Checklist items
items: Each item needs a name. Description, instructions, and importance (low / medium / high) are optional.
Items are not ticked here. Completion is recorded on the sale.
The same name at two scopes (for example project and unit) becomes two rows on the sale, each labeled with its scope.

sections.title: What happens after save
items: Open sales whose unit sits under this scope re-sync and gain the new items (unchecked).
Sales that already have a title-transfer date stay frozen and ignore this new config.
Tick the assembled list on Sales → Update handover.
